user.title: Add resident
user.description: Werner is set up once for every resident. Each resident needs their own Home Assistant user and the Home Assistant app on their phone.

data.name: Name (how Werner addresses them)
data.notify_service: Notify service of the resident's phone

data_description.notify_service: For example mobile_app_ericas_phone. Werner asks the resident here first.

error.notify_not_found: This notify service does not exist. Check the Home Assistant app on the resident's phone.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up in Werner.

init.title: How Werner notices activity
init.description: Choose what shows that the resident is active, e.g. the power meter, motion sensors or a tablet. Rules only run once at least one source is selected.

data_description.activity_sources: Each change counts as activity. For numbers such as power, only a rise above the base load counts.
data_description.baseload_w: Power that is always used (fridge, standby). Only more than this counts as activity.
data_description.weather: For the solar tips on the Energy screen.
data_description.grid_power: Current power from the grid, e.g. from the power meter.
data_description.pv_kwp: Peak power of the balcony or rooftop system, for the solar estimate.
data_description.charge_mode: The charging mode select of the charging point, e.g. from evcc.
data_description.signal_url: Leave empty: Werner finds the Signal Messenger app by itself. Otherwise e.g. http://<app>:8080.

rule_morning.name: Rule: nothing happening in the morning

rule_quiet.name: Rule: quiet for a long time

test_person.name: Send test message
test_person.description: Sends a test message to one of the resident's trusted persons.

ask.name: Ask the resident
ask.description: Werner asks the resident whether everything is all right – as if a rule had fired.

resident_not_found.message: This resident is not set up in Werner.
